description: baseline: return-period sub-types (1-2, 10-50, 100 yr), cap at 0.1 yr, median RSL, direct NOAA-ID gauges only
baseline method + nearest 1-degree grid cell RSL for the 122 counties whose gauge has no direct sea level row (coverage 234->356)

as 2 + gauges with NaN thresholds (61) take the median of the 126 known thresholds (full coverage)
as 3 but NaN-threshold gauges take the thresholds of the nearest gauge that has them (instead of global median)
